title: NVDM 1.1 scope registry entry
description: One entry of schemas/nvdm/scopes.json. The vocabularies are closed: appending a ref system, level or relation type is a one-line MINOR change, made when the first entry needs it. Graph rules (targets registered, administrative-parent acyclic, one country per place, method and evidence on every intersects) are enforced by scripts/validate_nvdm.py.

ref.description: A namespaced external identity (place model 4.1 PlaceRef). A code is never guessed: it is read from a file already in the repo or verified at its publisher.

as_of.description: Source vintage of the code, where known.

type.description: administrative-parent: place to parent place (place model 5). intersects: water system to a place it crosses, geometry only, never supply or entitlement (place model 6, 6.1). projection-of: an administrative view to its canonical water system (place model 7; the registry form of the envelope's projection.of).

method.description: How the relation was established (place model 6). geometry: the system's geometry in the repo was tested against the place's polygon. published: the source's publisher states it. crosswalk: joined through an identifier. manual: a reviewed mapping.

evidence.description: A repo path or URL that lets the relation be re-checked: for geometry, the boundary or centerline that was tested.
